arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test various integer formats
tests = [
    ('{:d}', '0xFF'),      # hex with d type
    ('{:d}', '0b1010'),    # binary with d type  
    ('{:d}', '0o755'),     # octal with d type
    ('{:d}', '12345'),     # plain decimal
    ('{:x}', 'FF'),        # hex explicit
    ('{:b}', '1010'),      # binary explicit
    ('{:o}', '755'),       # octal explicit
]

for fmt, s in tests:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, s)
    print(f'{fmt!r} on {s!r} -> {r.fixed if r else None}')
"
